verdict.rationale: LibreChat's agents can use MCP servers for file system access and other tools, and can execute code through its Code Interpreter. Together these could be assembled into a repo-working setup, but nothing documents supervising or embedding real coding agents doing repo work. Missing for 10: documented integration with or embedding of coding agents, git clone/branch/commit workflows, multi-file editing of a repository, running a project's test suite, and any hands-on corroboration of agentic repo work.
